name: ruffle-extension
description: Extension packaging for Ruffle Flash emulator

scripts.build: tsc -p jsconfig.json && npm run build:generic && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:generic: node build.js --env generic && node tools/inject_plugin_polyfill.ts && node tools/zip.ts dist/ruffle_extension.zip
scripts.build:firefox: node build.js --env firefox && node tools/inject_plugin_polyfill.ts && node tools/zip.ts dist/firefox_unsigned.xpi && npm run sign-firefox
